# Targets

The nouns of spec §8 — the resources a verb acts on. `schema` names the object contract a target's commands produce.

| target | category | schema | phase | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `process` | system | `ono.process/1` | C | A running process, identified by pid and start time to survive pid reuse. |
| `service` | system | `ono.service/1` | C | A service-manager unit as the active service provider sees it. |
| `job` | system | `ono.job/1` | F | A shell job — a backgrounded external pipeline or a detached native live view. |
| `thread` | system | `—` | planned | A thread of a process. |
| `file` | system | `ono.file/1` | C | A filesystem object and its metadata; path is a reference, inode is identity. |
| `dir` | system | `ono.file/1` | C | A directory, whose entries are File records. |
| `mount` | system | `ono.mount/1` | C | A mounted filesystem with its structured options. |
| `filesystem` | system | `ono.filesystem/1` | C | A filesystem or backing volume, mounted or not. |
| `device` | system | `—` | C | A block or character device. |
| `socket` | system | `ono.socket/1` | C | A socket with its endpoints, owning process and state. |
| `connection` | system | `—` | C | A connection-oriented view over sockets. |
| `interface` | system | `ono.interface/1` | C | A network interface with its addresses, state and counters. |
| `route` | system | `ono.route/1` | C | A routing table entry. |
| `neighbor` | system | `ono.neighbor/1` | C | An ARP or NDP neighbour entry. |
| `dns` | system | `—` | C | The name-resolution service, queried explicitly rather than implicitly. |
| `host` | system | `—` | H | A known host from a configured source, reachable or not. |
| `user` | system | `ono.user/1` | C | A user account, identified by uid, with the numeric identity kept when NSS cannot resolve it. |
| `group` | system | `ono.group/1` | C | A group account, identified by gid. |
| `session` | system | `—` | C | A login or seat session. |
| `env` | system | `ono.env-var/1` | C | The environment, as records rather than as a flat string namespace. |
| `command` | system | `—` | D | A native or external command and its metadata, as discoverable data. |
| `package` | system | `ono.package/1` | C | An installed or available package, through a package provider. |
| `kernel` | system | `—` | planned | The running kernel, its version and its parameters. |
| `module` | system | `—` | planned | A loaded kernel module. |
| `container` | system | `ono.container/1` | C | A container, through an installed container provider. |
| `namespace` | system | `—` | planned | A kernel namespace. Spec §8.3 lists a Kubernetes namespace under the same word; the two are distinguished by provider qualification — `get linux:namespace` and `get k8s:namespace`. |
| `cgroup` | system | `—` | planned | A control group and its resource accounting. |
| `journal` | system | `ono.journal-event/1` | C | The structured system journal. |
| `log` | system | `ono.log-record/1` | C | A log source, queried as records rather than parsed as text. |
| `port` | system | `—` | C | A transport port, as the subject of a reachability test. |
| `signal` | system | `—` | planned | A Unix signal, as the object a `send` or `kill` delivers. |
| `plugin` | system | `—` | I | A KUANG/11 package in one of its install/enable/load states (spec §31.8). |
| `capability` | system | `—` | I | A KUANG/11 capability definition, request, grant or lease (spec §31.16). |
| `assistant` | system | `—` | I | A loaded assistant extension (spec §31.41). |
| `model` | system | `—` | I | A configured model provider and its policy characteristics (spec §31.43). |
| `view` | system | `—` | I | A specialized view or TUI lens contributed by a package (spec §31.27). |
| `analysis` | system | `—` | I | An analysis program usable as a pipeline stage (spec §31.29). |
| `finding` | system | `—` | I | A finding emitted by an analysis or an assistant, with its evidence (spec §31.24). |
| `audit` | system | `—` | I | A capability-sensitive KUANG/11 action recorded in the audit trail (spec §31.37). |
| `link` | system | `—` | H | A persistent Ono remote execution link. |
| `context` | system | `—` | E | An entry on the context stack. |
| `config` | system | `ono.config-setting/1` | A | A resolved configuration setting with its provenance. |
| `repo` | development | `—` | planned | A source repository. |
| `branch` | development | `—` | planned | A branch within a repository. |
| `commit` | development | `—` | planned | A commit within a repository. |
| `worktree` | development | `—` | planned | A checked-out worktree of a repository. |
| `build` | development | `—` | planned | A build invocation and its outcome. |
| `test` | development | `—` | planned | A test case or test run. The word is also the `test` verb of §7.1; the two never collide because a target only ever appears after a verb. |
| `artifact` | development | `—` | planned | A build artifact. |
| `project` | development | `—` | planned | A project as its tooling defines it. |
| `pod` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A Kubernetes pod. |
| `node` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A cluster node. |
| `vm` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A virtual machine. |
| `image` | infrastructure | `ono.image/1` | C | A container or machine image. |
| `volume` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A storage volume managed by an infrastructure provider. |
| `network` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A managed virtual network. |
| `secret` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A managed secret. Values carry the secret semantic type: redacted by default, revealed only by an explicit action, and never entering history through renderer output (§17.5). |
| `endpoint` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A service endpoint exposed by an infrastructure provider. |
| `database` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A database instance or logical database. |
| `queue` | infrastructure | `—` | planned | A message queue or topic. |
